headline: Scale the product.
Not the design debt.
hero.body: Raft Design helps recently funded teams turn scattered brand, UX, and product decisions into a foundation the whole company can build from in four weeks.

problems.label: Design maturity gap
problems.headline: The design gap usually shows up before the design hire does.
problems.lead: At Series A, the product and team start growing faster than the decisions holding them together. You may already be seeing the signs.

items.title: The product still needs someone to explain it.
items.body: It works in a founder-led demo, but new users need help understanding the value or completing important workflows.

items.title: Every release adds another version of the same pattern.
items.body: With AI you ship features quickly, but the interface becomes less consistent and harder to extend.

items.title: Design decisions are scattered across the team.
items.body: Founders, PMs, and engineers make customer-experience decisions one ticket at a time.

items.title: The company tells a different story in every place.
items.body: The website, sales deck, demo, and product no longer feel like one company.

items.title: You need senior judgment before you need a design department.
items.body: The gap is already affecting the roadmap, but a full design team is still premature.

outcome.headline: Raft turns scattered decisions into a foundation the whole team can build from.

items.name: Clear brand
items.body: One story across product, sales, and marketing.

items.name: Stronger core UX
items.body: Important workflows that make sense without a guided demo.

items.name: Reusable product system
items.body: Shared patterns the team can extend without starting over.

scope.label: The scope
scope.headline: Brand first. Then the product that expresses it.
scope.lead: Why four weeks, not three: most sprints pick one lane. This does both, in the order that actually works.

steps.name: Define
steps.body: Direction-setting. Positioning, audience, and the design foundation everything else builds on.

steps.name: Brand
steps.body: Identity system: typography, color architecture, voice, and an investor-ready deck template.

steps.name: Product
steps.body: 5–10 high-fidelity screens, interactive prototype, edge cases mapped, built on the Week 2 system.

steps.name: Systemize
steps.body: Tokenized component library, fully documented handoff, recorded engineering walkthrough. Your team builds on it without you in the room.

track.label: Track record
track.headline: Happy clients. Real outcomes.
track.lead: An IPO on Nasdaq. Acquisitions by HPE and Tecsys. Companies still running and growing years later. What people who hired our founder have to say.

items.quote: “Lance seamlessly connected LegalOn’s U.S.-born brand with the cultural context of Japan. The brand architecture and framework he created gave us a clear way to express our core idea of ‘ON’ while keeping the brand cohesive as our product portfolio expanded.”
items.attribution: — Rin Yano, Chief Design Officer, LegalOn

items.quote: “LinkedIn only lets me rate Lance high on three attributes, but he actually delivers high on all: great results, personable, expert, good value, on time, high integrity and creative. Finding all of these in one person is very rare.”
items.attribution: — Karla Haley, Director of Demand Generation, Cloud Cruiser

items.quote: “Lance, and his team, did a fantastic job helping our company launch its new brand identity. He was directly involved in all aspects of the project, including the brand redesign strategy as well as the creative implementation on our fully redesigned website and other collateral.”
items.attribution: — Dan Burton, CEO at the time

items.quote: “I first worked with Lance's team at OrderDynamics on a website redesign. I thought their work was great and brought them in to redo our website at Leadspace. We went through an RFP process and reviewed several other vendors, but Lance's team stood out in terms of their creative talent and their unique experience in designing B2B websites focused on generating leads.”
items.attribution: — Kylee Hall, Director of Product Marketing, OrderDynamics and Leadspace

items.quote: “Lance and his team did an amazing job redesigning Leadspace.com. Really cutting edge work that helps us stand out in the competitive predictive analytics market. They were also great to work with, patient with our requests but helped guide us with a clear and thoughtful approach to design.”
items.attribution: — Damon Waldron, Director of Demand Generation, Leadspace

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.headline: The most direct way to hire senior design leadership.
pricing.lead: No hourly billing. No scope creep. No junior handoff. Just a fixed price for senior judgment, delivered in four weeks.

core.name: Core
core.description: Ideal for teams with some existing design foundation. You need a brand system and a working product to show investors and early customers, without the full weight of a mature product surface yet.
includes: Positioning, audience, experience principles
Core brand identity system (typography, color, voice)
Key sales and marketing templates
Up to 5 core product screens, high-fidelity
Interactive prototype
Core states and edge cases mapped
Component library and design tokens
Documentation and engineering handoff
AI-ready design system (DESIGN.md)
Everything built and delivered in Figma

full.name: Full System
full.description: Ideal for teams starting closer to zero. You need the full brand system and a broader product surface mapped and built, ready to hand to engineering across your whole app, not just a few key screens.
includes: Everything in Core, plus:
Expanded brand system: iconography/illustration style, extended template set (deck, social, email)
Full messaging framework: positioning statement, brand pillars, audience-specific messaging
8–10 product screens, high-fidelity
Deeper edge-case and state mapping across the full product surface
Expanded component library covering additional product surfaces
Everything built and delivered in Figma

land_expand.name: Land & Expand
land_expand.description: Ongoing fractional design leadership, roughly 15 hours a week, for teams that want to keep the brand and product functions running well without a full-time hire. Month to month, no fixed end date.

pricing.note: Currently taking a limited number of sprint engagements in exchange for case-study rights. If you're an early yes, the terms reflect that.

work.label: Selected work
work.headline: Startup and enterprise work, built to move.

ai.label: AI-ready design system
ai.headline: Your design system shouldn't stop at Figma.
ai.body: Every sprint includes an AI-ready design system, not just Figma files. Your brand rules, tokens, components, and DESIGN.md stay usable by your team and your AI tools long after the sprint ends.

items.question: How is this different from hiring a freelancer?
items.answer: You're working directly with someone who's led design at Adobe and Walmart scale, not delegating to a junior contractor. The output is also a full system, brand and product together, not a one-off deliverable.

items.question: What if we need more than 10 product screens?
items.answer: The Full System Sprint covers most funded startups' core surfaces. Larger scopes are quoted directly after the fit assessment call.

items.question: Do you work with teams outside the US?
items.answer: Raft works in English and Japanese.

items.question: What happens after the sprint ends?
items.answer: Most teams either take what's delivered and run with it in-house, or move into the Land & Expand fractional retainer to keep shipping with continued design leadership.

items.question: How soon can we start?
items.answer: Sprints typically start within four weeks of booking a fit assessment call, depending on current availability. Book a call to find the next open slot.

items.question: Will our product and roadmap details stay confidential?
items.answer: Yes. Happy to sign an NDA before any detailed discussion, just ask.

items.question: Why can't I just use AI tools myself?
items.answer: AI tools are powerful, but they don't know which choices are right for your specific business. The value isn't the AI, it's 25+ years of judgment directing it: knowing what to build, when it's right, and how to get there fast. Without that direction, AI accelerates guesswork just as easily as it accelerates good decisions.

items.question: How is this different from AI-Ready Design Systems?
answer: The Sprint is a fixed, one-time engagement that builds your brand and product foundation from the ground up.
is for teams that already have a system in place and want it restructured so their team and their AI tools can work from it directly. Most funded startups start with the Sprint.

hero.body: チームは速いペースでリリースを重ね、コードの多くをAIが書いています。デザインの土台がないまま速度だけが上がると、プロダクトは動いても、一つの会社がつくったものには感じられません。Raft Designは、その差を4週間で埋めます。まずブランド、次にそれを体現するプロダクトです。

scope.label: 支援内容
scope.headline: まずブランドを。次に、それを体現するプロダクトを。
scope.lead: なぜ3週間ではなく、4週間なのか。多くのスプリントは、ブランドかプロダクトのどちらかに集中します。このスプリントでは、両方を、成果につながる順序でつくります。

steps.name: 方向性の定義
steps.body: ポジショニング、ターゲット、そしてすべての起点となるデザイン基盤を定めます。

steps.name: ブランド
steps.body: 書体、配色体系、言葉づかいを一貫したブランドの仕組みにまとめます。投資家へのプレゼンテーションに使える資料テンプレートも整えます。

steps.name: プロダクト
steps.body: 第2週に築いた仕組みをもとに、細部まで設計した5〜10画面と、操作できるプロトタイプを制作します。例外的な操作や状況への対応も整理します。

steps.name: システム化
steps.body: デザイントークンで管理するコンポーネントライブラリ、実装に必要なドキュメント、開発チーム向けの説明動画を用意します。担当者がその場にいなくても、チームが自分たちで開発を進められる状態にします。

ai.label: AI対応デザインシステム
ai.headline: デザインシステムを、Figmaの中だけで終わらせない。
ai.body: すべてのスプリントに、AIが活用できるデザインシステムが含まれます。Figmaファイルに加え、ブランドルール、トークン、コンポーネント、DESIGN.mdを整備。スプリントが終わった後も、チームとAIツールの両方が使い続けられる基盤を残します。

items.question: フリーランスへの依頼とは、何が違いますか？
items.answer: AdobeやWalmartの規模でデザインを率いてきた担当者と、直接仕事を進められます。若手の外部スタッフに任せることはありません。また、単発の制作物ではなく、ブランドとプロダクトを一体で支える仕組みを納品します。

items.question: プロダクトの画面が10画面を超える場合は？
items.answer: Full Systemは、資金調達済みスタートアップの多くが必要とする主要画面をカバーします。より広い範囲の設計が必要な場合は、初回相談後に個別にお見積もりします。

items.question: 米国外のチームにも対応していますか？
items.answer: はい。Raftは米国と日本を拠点に、日本語と英語の両方で仕事を進めています。

items.question: スプリント終了後はどうなりますか？
items.answer: 納品したデザインや仕組みをもとに、自社チームで開発を進めることができます。継続的なデザインリーダーシップが必要な場合は、Land & Expandの継続契約に移行し、リリースを重ねていくこともできます。

items.question: いつから始められますか？
items.answer: 通常、初回相談のご予約から4週間以内に開始します。時期は稼働状況によって異なります。直近の開始可能日については、ご相談ください。

items.question: プロダクトやロードマップの情報は秘密として扱われますか？
items.answer: はい。詳しいお話を伺う前に、秘密保持契約（NDA）を締結できます。ご希望をお知らせください。

items.question: AIツールを自分たちで使うだけでは、足りませんか？
items.answer: AIツールは強力ですが、どの選択が自社の事業に適しているかまでは判断してくれません。Raftが提供する価値は、AIを使うこと自体ではなく、25年以上の経験に基づいてAIを使いこなす判断力です。何をつくるべきか、仕上がりをどう見極めるか、どうすればそこに速く到達できるか。その方向づけがなければ、AIは良い判断と同じ速さで、当てずっぽうの判断も加速させます。

items.question: AI対応デザインシステムのサービスとは、何が違いますか？
answer: このスプリントは、期間と範囲を定めた単発のプロジェクトで、ブランドとプロダクトの基盤をゼロから構築します。
AI対応デザインシステム
は、すでに仕組みがあり、それをチームとAIツールが直接活用できる形に再構成したい企業向けのサービスです。資金調達済みスタートアップの多くは、スプリントから始めています。
